Frequently Asked Questions

How long does an exchange typically take to complete?
The exchange process is generally completed in a few minutes, depending on the cryptocurrencies and network conditions. Most transactions are finalized within 10-15 minutes.
Can I exchange cryptocurrency without going through identity verification?
Many non KYC crypto exchanges allow you to perform transactions without identity verification. However, for some transactions, basic verification may still be required to ensure a safe and compliant service.
How do you ensure my privacy during exchanges?
We prioritize user privacy by employing advanced encryption methods and strictly following privacy policies. Your personal and financial data is never shared without your consent.
What are the transaction fees on your platform?
Our platform charges a nominal transaction fee, which varies depending on the type of exchange and cryptocurrencies involved. You’ll always see the fee before confirming the exchange.
Are there limits on the amount of cryptocurrency I can exchange?
Yes, limits may apply based on your account's verification level. These limits are clearly displayed on the exchange platform and can be increased after completing further verification steps if required.
Can I cancel a transaction once it's been initiated?
Once an exchange is initiated, it cannot be reversed. We recommend reviewing all details carefully before proceeding to avoid any mistakes.
How frequently are cryptocurrency rates updated?
Cryptocurrency rates are updated in real-time, ensuring that you receive the most accurate and up-to-date exchange rates.
What should I do if I encounter any issues during an exchange?
If you experience any technical difficulties, please reach out to our support team. Our experts are available 24/7 to assist and resolve any issues as quickly as possible.
Is your non KYC exchange service available worldwide?
Yes, our service is accessible globally. You can use our platform from anywhere in the world to exchange cryptocurrencies without the need for identity verification.
Do I need a cryptocurrency wallet to use the exchange?
Yes, a cryptocurrency wallet is necessary to receive and store the exchanged coins. If you don’t have one, we can recommend reliable wallet providers to help you get started.
